label: دوار
setting: in a legal parking space near a roundabout
parking: Park in a legal marked layby near but never inside the roundabout or travel lane.
ground: Old patched asphalt, faded lane markings, dusty concrete islands where actually present.
background: The roundabout approach and faded road markings only if the safe selfie view includes them.
angleReason: Use a physically reachable front-camera selfie, placing the reference face first and keeping the real vehicle parking arrangement intact.

day.source: Natural 5500K daylight from single sun/sky, with real dust and shade from actual structures only.
day.shadows: Away from actual daylight with small consistent contact shadows.
day.reflections: Natural subdued glass and bodywork reflection.

night.source: One already present road, kiosk or shelter light, warm 3000K, with shadows away from the actual fixture.
night.shadows: Only source-aligned shadows or weak dim sky contrast.
night.reflections: Weak real reflections without studio fill.
